idea.title: Show HN: Git for AI Agents

plan.tagline: Version control for AI agents to track, compare, and rollback their work
plan.problem: AI agents produce outputs (code, data, reports) without versioning, making it impossible to track changes, compare versions, or recover from mistakes
plan.solution: A lightweight CLI tool that snapshots agent outputs, tracks changes, and allows rollback—like Git but for AI-generated artifacts
plan.target_market: Indie hackers and small dev teams using AI agents for automation, content creation, or data processing

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for storing snapshots + add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: generate diff reports + basic alerts for changes

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with hardcoded data + --help + edge cases

plan.demo_script: Run `agentgit --demo` to see 3 snapshots of AI-generated code with diffs, then rollback to v1. All offline with no setup.
